title: DailyEvents
description: Every Minecraft sunrise, a new random rule is selected and announced to all players. The rule stays active until the next sunrise. Only one rule is active at a time. The last 2 rules are remembered to prevent repeats.
body:
Every Minecraft sunrise brings a new random rule that changes gameplay for the entire day.
17 rules included across 3 tiers:
🟢 **Common** — Speed Boost, Low Gravity, No Fall Damage, Double Drops, Night Vision, Super Jump, Super Strength
🟡 **Uncommon** — Starvation, War Zone, Chaos Potions, Turbo Mobs, Dagestan Mobs, Undying, Toxic World
🔴 **Rare** — One Punch, Glass Body, Anti-Gravity
How it works:
A new rule is announced every sunrise with a title screen message
Rules cannot repeat for 2 days in a row
Rarer rules appear less frequently
Players who join mid-day are shown the current active rule
